title: \\\"GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization\\\"\\n    authors: NVIDIA Labs\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ICML 2026\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: closest_prior_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，\\n      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，\\n      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），\\n      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。\\n      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs\\\"\\n    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2505.09655\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。\\n      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，\\n      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。\\n      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards\\\"\\n    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2511.03710\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。\\n      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，\\n      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。\\n      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2502.18770\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770\\n    category: reward_diversity\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，\\n      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，\\n      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合\\\"先快后慢\\\"的 reward shaping 原则。\\n\\n  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale\\\"\\n    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: NeurIPS 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: key_baseline\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。\\n      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling\\n      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，\\n      无需额外 clip 调整。reward design vs. algorithm trick 的对比。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO\\\"\\n    authors: Liu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: COLM 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: related_analysis\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。\\n      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），\\n      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。\\n      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: NeurIPS 2025\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: alternative_framework\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，\\n      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，\\n      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization\\\"\\n    authors: Jian Hu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2501.03262\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。\\n      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。\\n      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO\\\"\\n    authors: Henglin Liu et al.\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2512.21514\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: parallel_work\\n    key_finding: >\\n      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）\\n      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——\\n      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2601.23135\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135\\n    category: mode_collapse_prevention\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，\\n      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，\\n      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。\\n\\n  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards\\\"\\n    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: arXiv 2403.07708\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: closest_contrastive_precedent\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Contrastive reward 让 LLM 惩罚 reward uncertainty、改善鲁棒性、\\n      根据任务难度自适应校准、减少 PPO 中的 variance。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      最接近的对比 reward 先例。但针对 RLHF 通用场景，\\n      CED 是 task-specific evidence discrimination 对比信号，且在 GRPO（非 PPO）中验证。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: EMNLP 2024\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，\\n      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，\\n      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: ICLR 2025\\n    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj\\n    category: contrastive_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。\\n\\n  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: ACL 2025\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: related_method\\n    key_finding: >\\n      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination\\n      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: EACL 2024\\n    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2024\\n    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024\\n    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/\\n    category: evidence_reward\\n    role: background\\n    key_finding: >\\n      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，\\n      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。\\n\\n  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===\\n\\n  - title: \\\"Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: OpenReview\\n    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU\\n    category: multi_objective_rl\\n    role: related_analysis\\n    key_finding: >\\n      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，\\n      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），\\n      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，\\n      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。\\n\\n  - title: \\\"On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline\\\"\\n    authors: Anonymous\\n    year: 2025\\n    venue: arXiv 2505.23585\\n    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585\\n    category: multi_objective_rl\\n    role: theoretical_support\\n    key_finding: >\\n      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，\\n      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。\\n    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >\\n      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——\\n      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。\\n\", \"total_chars\": 10421, \"truncated\": false}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710

    key_finding: >

    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。

Based on the web search results, I found several relevant papers and discussions about reward language models and related techniques in 2025-2026:

## Key Research Areas

Natural language is being explored to specify rewards in Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), with Large Language Models being used to translate rich text feedback into state-level labels for training.

Sequence to Sequence Reward Modeling is being investigated as a method for improving RLHF by language feedback, with this work appearing in the 2025 Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence.

## Broader Reward Modeling Landscape

Several benchmarking and evaluation advances have emerged in 2025:

- RewardBench 2 has been released to advance reward model evaluation
- Generative verifiers are being developed for reward modeling as next-token prediction

## Key Findings

**Contrastive Learning in NLI and Relation Extraction:**

Contrastive learning methods introduce label-supervised tasks to help encoders learn discriminative representations for different-label claim-evidence pairs, as well as unsupervised graph-contrast tasks to alleviate the loss of unique node features in graph propagation.

**Evidence Discrimination Challenge:**

In NLI-based methods, there's a challenge where semantically-similar claims and evidences probably have different authenticity labels, and a good fact verification model should have the discrimination capacity to learn well-separated representations for semantics-similar cases with different authenticity labels.

**Application to Relation Extraction:**

Techniques augment positive pairs to increase their diversity and strengthen the discriminative power of contrastive learning through within-sentence pairs augmentation and augmentation through cross-sentence pairs extraction. Additionally, cross-sentence positive pairs are extracted by utilizing an OpenIE model to extract relation templates and employing NLI to discover mutually entailed templates.

**Document-Level Relation Extraction:**

For document-level relation extraction, researchers aim to achieve better integration of both discriminability and robustness, customizing entropy minimization and supervised contrastive learning for multi-label and long-tailed learning problems.

These approaches collectively demonstrate how contrastive learning and evidence discrimination techniques enhance model performance across NLI and relation extraction tasks.

Based on the search results, here's what I found on document-level relation extraction with evidence and the DocRED dataset:

## DocRED Dataset Overview

DocRED is a large-scale document-level relation extraction dataset constructed from Wikipedia and Wikidata, annotating both named entities and relations. The dataset requires reading multiple sentences in a document to extract entities and infer their relations by synthesizing all information of the document.

## Recent Research on Evidence-Based Document-Level Relation Extraction (2025-2026)

Recent work has focused on leveraging evidence sentences to improve extraction performance:

Document-level RE models now leverage Enhancing Cross-evidence Reasoning Graph (ECRG) for improved performance. These approaches design evidence extraction rules based on center-sentence to pre-extract higher-quality evidence, then construct evidence into evidence graphs to mine connections between mentions.

Recent work includes GEGA: Graph convolutional networks and evidence retrieval guided attention for enhanced document-level relation extraction (2025), and VaeDiff-DocRE: An end-to-end data augmentation framework for document-level relation extraction (2025).

## Key Challenges and Methods

Only a small subset of textual content in a document typically provides factual support for a given relation, complicating both prediction and evaluation. Evidence estimation methods such as Eider extract minimal "evidence sets" by learning sentence importance for each entity pair, then fuse predictions from full-document and evidence-focused subdocuments.

Based on the search results, here's an overview of recent work on rejection sampling fine-tuning from 2025-2026:

## Core Concepts and Applications

Rejection sampling operates by curating new candidate completions, filtering them based on a trained reward model, and then fine-tuning the original model only on the top completions. RSFT has become the prevailing baseline for self-improvement in mathematical reasoning and chain-of-thought LLMs.

## Recent Advances (2025-2026)

**Theoretical Connections:** Researchers have established connections between Rejection Sampling based fine-tuning and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), with work presented at ICML 2025 exploring these relationships.

**Adaptive Methods:** AdaSTaR addresses the inefficiency of classical RFT's random sampling with adaptive heaps and curriculum mechanisms—leveraging performance statistics to prioritize examples, balance diversity, and align training difficulty with capability.

**Generalization Beyond Mathematics:** While originally developed for mathematical reasoning, RSFT's accept-reject paradigm generalizes to RLHF and alignment, filtering model outputs by reward model gaps or preference probabilities. Applications include robotic manipulation with online rejection sampling and human-in-the-loop corrections, which demonstrably improves policy robustness and error recovery in real-world manipulation.

**Inference-Time Methods:** STARS operates at inference-time, segmenting generation into fixed-size blocks and applying rejection sampling blockwise based on a scalar reward model.

The search results focus primarily on mathematical reasoning and general language model alignment rather than relation extraction specifically. If you need information specifically about relation extraction applications, a more targeted search might be helpful.

## Overview of Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning

Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) performs supervised training on filtered sets of correct trajectories. While RSFT has become the prevailing baseline for self-improvement in mathematical reasoning and chain-of-thought LLMs, recent research in 2025 has expanded its applications significantly.

## Applications Beyond Math Reasoning

While initially developed for chain-of-thought mathematical reasoning, RSFT's accept-reject paradigm generalizes: RLHF and Alignment involve filtering model outputs by reward model gaps or preference probabilities, generating synthetic contrastive datasets for DPO. Additionally, rejection sampling is used in robotic manipulation with online rejection sampling and human-in-the-loop corrections, which demonstrably improves policy robustness and error recovery in real-world manipulation.

## Recent Advances (2025)

Comprehensive experiments across math, reasoning, and summarization/dialogue benchmarks validate its effectiveness. Recent innovations include:

- AdaSTaR addresses the inefficiency of classical RFT's random sampling with adaptive heaps and curriculum mechanisms—leveraging performance statistics to prioritize examples, balance diversity, and align training difficulty with capability.

- TrajFusion fuses incorrect trajectories with correct ones, interleaving them to explicitly model trial-and-error reasoning and reflection.

The research landscape shows that rejection sampling techniques are evolving to address broader NLP tasks with more sophisticated approaches to sample selection and trajectory fusion.

## RelPrior Overview

RelPrior is a novel Relation as a Prior (RelPrior) paradigm for LLM-based DocRE that was introduced in 2025. LLMs still exhibit performance gaps in Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) as requiring fine-grained comprehension.

## Problem Statement

The commonly adopted "extract entities then predict relations" paradigm in LLM-based methods leads to gaps due to: (1) Numerous unrelated entity pairs introduce noise and interfere with the relation prediction for truly related entity pairs, and (2) Although LLMs have identified semantic associations between entities, relation labels beyond the predefined set are still treated as prediction errors.

## RelPrior Solution

RelPrior utilizes binary relation as a prior to extract and determine whether two entities are correlated, thereby filtering out irrelevant entity pairs and reducing prediction noise. Additionally, RelPrior utilizes predefined relation as a prior to match entities for triples extraction instead of directly predicting relation. Thus, it avoids misjudgment caused by strict predefined relation labeling.

## Performance

Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that RelPrior achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing LLM-based methods.

## R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR (arXiv 2507.04642)

R1-RE is the first reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) framework for relation extraction (RE) tasks, which reframes RE as a reasoning task guided by annotation guidelines.

### Problem and Approach

Traditional approaches frame RE as a supervised learning problem, directly mapping context to labels—an approach that often suffers from poor out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. The R1-RE method elicits the reasoning abilities of small language models for annotation tasks, resulting in significantly improved OOD robustness.

### Results

The R1-RE-7B model attains an average OOD accuracy of approximately 70%, on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-4o. The approach was evaluated on the public Sem-2010 dataset and a private MDKG dataset.

### Key Insights

The research provides novel insights into the training dynamics and emergent reasoning behaviors of the RLVR paradigm for RE.

The paper is authored by Runpeng Dai and colleagues and was published on arXiv in July 2025.

## Recent New Methods (2024-2026)

### LMRC (LLM with Relation Classifier)
A novel method named LMRC (LLM with Relation Classifier) aims at bridging the performance gap between LLM-based DocRE methods and their conventional counterparts. LMRC conceptualizes DocRE as a workflow comprising two stages: Relation Candidate Proposal (RCP) and Relation Classification (RC), where in the RCP stage a pre-processing classifier is applied to filter out NA entity pairs that do not harbour any relation. Experimental results on the DocRED and Re-DocRED benchmarks show that LMRC gains significant improvement over other LLM-based DocRE methods.

### AutoRE
AutoRE is an end-to-end DocRE model that adopts a novel RE extraction paradigm named RHF (Relation-Head-Facts). AutoRE was fine-tuned using the Mistral-7B with QLoRA and achieved SOTA results across multiple pre-trained LLMs (PLMs).

### ToolRE (2025)
ToolRE is a novel framework that leverages LLMs for DocRE through self-verification and tool-assisted relational reasoning, designed with three tools for entity extraction, explicit relation extraction, and complex relation extraction.

### Ru-LLM (2025-2026)
Ru-LLM transforms logical rules into concise prompts to guide initial result generation, subjected to a Chain-of-Thought verification process, and experimental results on DWIE, DocRED, and Re-DocRED demonstrate that Ru-LLM outperforms existing implicit reasoning models, LLM-based models, and rule-based frameworks.

These methods address key challenges in LLM-based document-level relation extraction, including handling class imbalance in the candidate space and improving performance on long-tail relations.

Based on the search results, I found information about the ICML 2025 paper on this topic:

The paper establishes connections between Rejection Sampling based fine-tuning and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and uses this formalism to establish PPO with marginal KL constraints for diffusion models.

The paper was published on June 10, 2025, and presented as a poster at ICML 2025 PUT (Publications and Updating Track). The key insight is that exact PPO for Diffusion Models can be done through rejection sampling based fine-tuning, and this can be made more efficient by fine-tuning only earlier denoising timesteps.

This research reveals an interesting theoretical connection: that rejection sampling-based fine-tuning, which is often thought of as a simpler alternative to PPO, actually implicitly performs PPO under certain conditions, particularly in the context of diffusion models. The work provides a more efficient variant by focusing the fine-tuning on earlier denoising steps rather than all steps.

The paper also notes that recent studies indicate that SFT tends to promote memorization of training data, thereby impairing out-of-domain generalization, whereas RL-based methods can facilitate better skill transfer and generalization across diverse tasks.

## Overview

Graph-R1 is an ICML 2026 paper titled "Towards Agentic GraphRAG Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning", authored by Haoran Luo, Haihong E, Guanting Chen, Qika Lin, Yikai Guo, Fangzhi Xu, Zemin Kuang, Meina Song, Xiaobao Wu, Yifan Zhu, and Luu Anh Tuan.

## Key Innovation

Graph-R1 is an end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) framework designed to improve reasoning-on-graph capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The framework addresses limitations in existing GraphRAG methods through three main components:

1. **Knowledge Hypergraph Construction**: The system constructs a knowledge hypergraph using n-ary relation extraction

2. **Multi-Turn Agentic Reasoning**: It employs an explicit reward mechanism within RL, enabling the LLM to iteratively execute a "think–generate query–retrieve subgraph–rethink" reasoning cycle

3. **End-to-End RL Optimization**: It introduces lightweight knowledge hypergraph construction, models retrieval as a multi-turn agent-environment interaction, and optimizes the agent process via an end-to-end reward mechanism

## Performance

Experiments on standard RAG datasets show that Graph-R1 outperforms traditional GraphRAG and RL-enhanced RAG methods in reasoning accuracy, retrieval efficiency, and generation quality.

The official repository is available on GitHub at LHRLAB/Graph-R1, with the paper also published on arXiv.

I found relevant results for your search. The primary match is a recent arXiv paper from February 2026:

## TrajFusion: Beyond Rejection Sampling for Mathematical Reasoning

Large language models (LLMs) have made impressive strides in mathematical reasoning, often fine-tuned using rejection sampling that retains only correct reasoning trajectories. However, this paradigm treats supervision as a binary filter that systematically excludes teacher-generated errors, leaving a gap in how reasoning failures are modeled during training.

The paper proposes TrajFusion, a fine-tuning strategy that reframes rejection sampling as a structured supervision construction process. Specifically, TrajFusion forms fused trajectories that explicitly model trial-and-error reasoning by interleaving selected incorrect trajectories with reflection prompts and correct trajectories.

**Key Features:**

- The length of each fused sample is adaptively controlled based on the frequency and diversity of teacher errors, providing richer supervision for challenging problems while safely reducing to vanilla rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) when error signals are uninformative.

- TrajFusion requires no changes to the architecture or training objective.

- Extensive experiments across multiple math benchmarks demonstrate that TrajFusion consistently outperforms RFT, particularly on challenging and long-form reasoning problems.

**Paper Details:** The paper (arXiv:2602.04391) was submitted on February 4, 2026, by Jie Deng and colleagues.

## Recent Research on NLI and Reward Signals for LLM Training

### Reward Modeling and Faithfulness
Faithfulness bias arises when a reward model favors plausible explanations over faithful ones, because reward models can observe only generated text but lack direct access to whether an explanation accurately reflects the model's internal reasoning process.

### Using NLI for Hallucination and Faithfulness Assessment
Textual entailment-based metrics assess whether ground-truth knowledge entails model's generations using a NLI model, and while the "neutral" label in NLI often fails to explicitly indicate hallucination in generated content, many studies still interpret the neutral label as indicative of hallucination from the perspective of faithfulness.

### NLI with Explanation Generation
Recent work in 2025-2026 has focused on improving NLI interpretability. Prompt engineering develops prompt templates that explicitly enforce conciseness and faithfulness, enabling LLMs to serve as effective automated explanation annotators.

### Reward Signals in Chain-of-Thought Training
Training with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in CoT frameworks enables chain-style answer explanation without annotated rationales, using reward signals for explanation quality and answer consistency.

### Logic-Based Reward Signals
LogicReward enhances reasoning faithfulness, improves generalizability to unseen tasks such as math and commonsense reasoning, and provides a reliable reward signal even without ground-truth labels.

The research indicates an active area of development in using NLI as a component of reward signals to improve LLM training, with particular emphasis on addressing faithfulness challenges.

The search found the paper you're looking for! Here's what I found:

"A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce" examines how reinforcement learning has become a prevailing approach for fine-tuning large language models on complex reasoning tasks, with methods like GRPO showing empirical success in training models such as DeepSeek-R1, though the sources of its effectiveness remain poorly understood.

The paper finds that a simple rejection sampling baseline called RAFT, which trains only on positively rewarded samples, yields competitive performance compared to GRPO and PPO.

The authors' ablation studies reveal that GRPO's main advantage comes from discarding prompts with entirely incorrect responses rather than from its reward normalization, and they propose Reinforce-Rej, a minimal extension of policy gradient that filters both entirely incorrect and entirely correct samples.

The paper was submitted on April 15, 2025 and last revised on June 12, 2025 (arXiv:2504.11343). You can access the full paper directly on arXiv at https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343.

Based on the search results, here's information about the arxiv paper 2506.18670:

## Paper Overview

The paper presents an LLM-based retriever empowered to augment both user queries and corpus documents, with its policy fully explored via reinforcement learning (RL) and minimal human inductive bias.

## Title and Authors

The paper is titled "Harnessing the Power of Reinforcement Learning for Language-Model-Based Information Retriever via Query-Document Co-Augmentation" by Jingming Liu, Yumeng Li, Wei Shi, Yao-Xiang Ding, Hui Su, and Kun Zhou.

## Key Contributions

For challenging corpora, the authors argue that enhancing queries alone is insufficient for robust semantic matching; the LLM should also understand the corpus by augmenting documents, and they find that simply allowing the LLM to modify documents yields little benefit unless paired with a carefully designed bidirectional RL framework.

The results show that their approach successfully enabled learning an effective bidirectional augmentation policy which significantly enhances performance, and the learned LLM-retriever policy achieves desirable cross-benchmark generalization ability.

The paper was submitted to arXiv on June 23, 2025, and is categorized under Information Retrieval (cs.IR).

Based on the search results, I found relevant information about Ru-LLM and related research on logical rule-constrained approaches for document-level relation extraction.

## Ru-LLM Overview

Ru-LLM is a novel framework that learns logical rules to enhance the performance of LLMs in DocRE (Document-level Relation Extraction).

## Framework Approach

Ru-LLM leverages frequent pattern mining and LLM-assisted completion to obtain the candidate predicate pool, and incorporates the Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to efficiently search for and generate logical rules through a four-stage process: selection, expansion, simulation, and backpropagation.

## Implementation Strategy

Ru-LLM transforms logical rules into concise prompts to guide initial result generation, which is then subjected to a Chain-of-Thought verification process that retains only those triples satisfying all rules.

## Experimental Results

Experimental results on the three datasets DWIE, DocRED, and Re-DocRED demonstrate that Ru-LLM outperforms existing implicit reasoning models, LLM-based models, and rule-based frameworks.

## Publication

The paper "Logical Rule-Constrained Large Language Models for Document-Level Relation Extraction" was published in 2026 and appears in the Natural Language Processing and Chinese Computing proceedings (NLPCC 2025).

## GLiDRE: Generalist Lightweight Document Relation Extraction

GLiDRE is a new and efficient model for document-level relation extraction with zero or few annotated data, that leverages embedding similarities between relation types and entity pair representations.

**Key Features:**

- GLiDRE uses a dual-encoder structure where a text encoder generates token embeddings and a label encoder computes embeddings for relation types. An entity representation is formed by pooling the embeddings of its constituent tokens and mentions, and for each entity pair, their representations are concatenated and processed by a feed-forward network before final scoring.

**Performance:**

GLiDRE achieves state-of-the-art results in challenging few-shot scenarios on the Re-DocRED, FREDo and Re-FREDo benchmarks.

**Training Data:**

The resulting dataset contains 136,404 documents with highly diverse labels, featuring 76,497 unique relation types. For better generalization, GLiDRE benefits from pretraining on a large-scale generalist annotated corpus.

**Availability:**

GLiDRE is a generalist and lightweight model designed for Document Relation Extraction that enables users to extract and classify relationships among entities within unstructured text documents, built upon the success of previous work GLiNER. The code is available on GitHub.

Based on the search results, I found information about the LMRC (LLM with Relation Classifier) approach for document-level relation extraction:

## Overview

LMRC (Large Language Models with Relation Classifier) is an approach for document-level relation extraction (DocRE). LMRC conceptualizes DocRE as a workflow comprising two key stages: Relation Candidate Proposal (RCP) and Relation Classification (RC).

## Method

In the RCP stage, a pre-processing classifier is employed, which harnesses attention mechanism to filter out NA entity pairs that do not harbour any relation, significantly narrowing down the scope of candidate space. Subsequently, the RC stage leverages the power of LLMs to perform multi-classification within this refined candidate space.

## Performance Results

Before implementing LMRC, the extraction performances of GPT models were quite low, while their overall F1 scores were significantly improved after integrating LMRC strategy. Experimental results on the DocRED and Re-DocRED benchmarks showed that the proposed LMRC gains significant improvement over other LLM-based DocRE methods. Additionally, experiments on DocRE benchmarks reveal that the method significantly outperforms recent LLM-based DocRE models and narrows the performance gap with state-of-the-art BERT-based models.

## Problem Addressed

The paper identifies the dispersion of attention by LLMs due to entity pairs without relations as a primary factor causing the performance gap in document-level relation extraction tasks.

## "Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Planning: Harnessing Large Language Models for Complex Information Extraction"

Large language models can solve information extraction tasks through multi-step planning, but their extraction behavior on complex sentences and tasks is unstable, with issues such as false positives and missing elements.

**Key Contribution:**
The paper proposes a two-stage multi-step method for LLM-based information extraction using the RL framework, regarding sequential extraction as a Markov decision process, building an LLM-based extraction environment, designing a decision module to adaptively provide the optimal order for sequential entity extraction on different sentences, and utilizing the DDQN algorithm to train the decision model.

**Main Findings:**
The research observes that decomposing complex extraction tasks and extracting them step by step can effectively improve LLMs' performance, and the extraction orders of entities significantly affect the final results of LLMs.

**Authors:** Zepeng Ding, Ruiyang Ke, Wenhao Huang, Guochao Jiang, Yanda Li, Deqing Yang, and Jiaqing Liang

**Publication:** Submitted on 17 June 2024 (v1), last revised 29 August 2024 (v2)

Now I have a comprehensive view of the landscape. Let me compile my findings and write the literature report and update the literature map.

Key findings:

**Direct competitors / closely related:**

1. **R1-RE** (arXiv 2507.04642, Jul 2025) - First RLVR framework for RE. Uses GRPO with verifiable rewards for relation extraction. Evaluated on SemEval-2010 and private MDKG dataset, NOT DocRED. Focus on cross-domain OOD generalization, not document-level RE or evidence extraction. Key difference from us: sentence-level RE, no evidence component, no rejection sampling.


2. **MORE-R1** (arXiv 2603.09478, Mar 2026) - Extends RL-based RE to multimodal settings with vision-language data and GRPO, showing the broader trend of applying reinforcement learning across different RE modalities.
3. **REAR** (EMNLP 2025 Findings) - Uses RL for event argument extraction with relation-aware reasoning, demonstrating similar RL approaches in related information extraction tasks.
4. **Graph-R1** (ICML 2026, arXiv 2507.21892) - Applies end-to-end RL with GRPO to knowledge graph construction through agentic GraphRAG, showing RL's application in graph-based extraction tasks.

Now looking at the DocRE-specific methods: RelPrior frames relations as priors for LLM-based DocRE with solid improvements, LMRC uses a two-stage filtering approach with a dedicated relation classifier, Ru-LLM incorporates logical rules discovered via MCTS that get converted to prompts, and GLiDRE appears to be another recent approach from August.

I'm also tracking AutoRE which does end-to-end DocRE with QLoRA fine-tuning, and ToolRE which adds self-verification through tool assistance.

On the RSFT side, there's an ICML paper drawing theoretical connections between RSFT and PPO in the diffusion model space, and a minimalist approach showing that basic rejection sampling can be competitive with more complex methods like GRPO.

TrajFusion goes beyond simple rejection sampling by fusing incorrect and correct trajectories for math reasoning, and there's work on adaptive RL planning for information extraction that optimizes entity extraction ordering.

Looking at our novelty, it's genuinely strong—no one has applied RSFT or rejection sampling specifically to DocRE or relation extraction tasks, and the NLI-based evidence quality as a reward signal is completely novel to this space. The performance gains we're seeing are substantial.

Now I need to update the literature map with entries covering RSFT methodology and RL approaches for IE, then write up the scan report.

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。

    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。

    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >

      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      Contrastive reward 让 LLM 惩罚 reward uncertainty、改善鲁棒性、
      根据任务难度自适应校准、减少 PPO 中的 variance。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。但针对 RLHF 通用场景，
      CED 是 task-specific evidence discrimination 对比信号，且在 GRPO（非 PPO）中验证。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败的原因可能是
      structured output（DocRE）比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      而 rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，
      媲美 GPT-4o。在 SemEval-2010 Task 8 和私有 MDKG 数据集上评估。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。但关键差异：(1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，我们是文档级 RE；
      (2) R1-RE 用 online GRPO，我们用 offline RSFT；
      (3) R1-RE 无 evidence extraction 组件，我们有 CED reward；
      (4) R1-RE 关注 OOD 泛化，我们关注 evidence-grounded extraction quality。
      互补而非直接冲突。

  - title: "MORE-R1: Guiding LVLM for Multimodal Object-Entity Relation Extraction via Stepwise Reasoning with RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.09478
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09478
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      多模态 RE 中用 GRPO + Progressive Sample-Mixing Strategy 优化 LVLM 推理能力。
      两阶段训练：SFT cold-start + GRPO RL。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      跨模态验证 RL for RE 趋势。其 Progressive Sample-Mixing 与我们
      RSFT 的 difficulty-aware sampling 思想相通，但在不同模态。

  - title: "REAR: Reinforced Reasoning Optimization for Event Argument Extraction with Relation-Aware Support"
    authors: Jianwen Luo et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: EMNLP 2025 Findings
    url: https://2025.emnlp.org/program/find_papers/
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      将强化学习推理优化用于事件论元抽取，结合关系感知支持。
      不同于 DocRE 但同属 IE 领域的 RL 应用。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      验证 RL 在 IE 任务上的有效性趋势。我们的工作扩展到 DocRE + evidence，
      且使用 offline RSFT 而非 online RL。

  - title: "Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Planning: Harnessing LLMs for Complex Information Extraction"
    authors: Zepeng Ding et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2406.11455
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11455
    category: rl_for_ie

      RL for IE 的早期工作。用 RL 优化抽取策略而非模型本身，

    venue: ICML 2026

    category: rl_for_ie
    role: background

    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      RL + knowledge extraction 的交叉点。Graph-R1 关注 QA 场景下的知识图谱构建，

  # === Category 8: Recent LLM-based DocRE Methods ===

  - title: "RelPrior: Relation as a Prior - A Novel Paradigm for LLM-based Document-level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.08143
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08143
    category: llm_docre
    role: key_baseline

      用 binary relation 作为先验过滤无关实体对，再用 predefined relation 匹配实体，

    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      我们的直接 baseline 之一。RelPrior 在 DocRED 上提升 +2.06-2.38pp，
      我们的 RSFT 提升 +5.98pp 显著更优。
      RelPrior 是 inference paradigm 创新，我们是 training paradigm 创新，正交互补。

    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2408.13889
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.13889
    category: llm_docre
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      两阶段方法：先用 attention-based classifier 过滤 NA 实体对（RCP），

  - title: "Ru-LLM: Logical Rule-Constrained Large Language Models for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025

    category: llm_docre
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用频繁模式挖掘 + MCTS 搜索逻辑规则，转化为 prompt 约束 LLM 输出，

    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2508.00757
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00757
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      基于 dual-encoder 的轻量级零/少样本 DocRE 模型，
      在 Re-DocRED、FREDo 等 benchmark 的 few-shot 场景达到 SOTA。
      预训练于 136K 文档的大规模 RE 数据。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      不同范式（encoder-based vs LLM generative），
      但验证了 DocRE 领域仍有方法创新空间。

  - title: "AutoRE: Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.14888
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14888
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RHF（Relation-Head-Facts）范式用 Mistral-7B + QLoRA 做端到端 DocRE，
      在多个 LLM 上达到 SOTA。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      QLoRA fine-tuning for DocRE 的先例。我们的 SFT baseline 与之类似，
      RSFT 在此基础上引入 reward-guided sample selection 进一步提升。

# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling
      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，
      无需额外 clip 调整。reward design vs. algorithm trick 的对比。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），
      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。
      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      Contrastive reward 让 LLM 惩罚 reward uncertainty、改善鲁棒性、
      根据任务难度自适应校准、减少 PPO 中的 variance。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。但针对 RLHF 通用场景，
      CED 是 task-specific evidence discrimination 对比信号，且在 GRPO（非 PPO）中验证。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败的原因可能是
      structured output（DocRE）比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      而 rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，
      媲美 GPT-4o。在 SemEval-2010 Task 8 和私有 MDKG 数据集上评估。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。但关键差异：(1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，我们是文档级 RE；
      (2) R1-RE 用 online GRPO，我们用 offline RSFT；
      (3) R1-RE 无 evidence extraction 组件，我们有 CED reward；
      (4) R1-RE 关注 OOD 泛化，我们关注 evidence-grounded extraction quality。
      互补而非直接冲突。

  - title: "MORE-R1: Guiding LVLM for Multimodal Object-Entity Relation Extraction via Stepwise Reasoning with RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.09478
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09478
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      多模态 RE 中用 GRPO + Progressive Sample-Mixing Strategy 优化 LVLM 推理能力。
      两阶段训练：SFT cold-start + GRPO RL。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      跨模态验证 RL for RE 趋势。其 Progressive Sample-Mixing 与我们
      RSFT 的 difficulty-aware sampling 思想相通，但在不同模态。

  - title: "REAR: Reinforced Reasoning Optimization for Event Argument Extraction with Relation-Aware Support"
    authors: Jianwen Luo et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: EMNLP 2025 Findings
    url: https://2025.emnlp.org/program/find_papers/
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      将强化学习推理优化用于事件论元抽取，结合关系感知支持。
      不同于 DocRE 但同属 IE 领域的 RL 应用。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      验证 RL 在 IE 任务上的有效性趋势。我们的工作扩展到 DocRE + evidence，
      且使用 offline RSFT 而非 online RL。

  - title: "Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Planning: Harnessing LLMs for Complex Information Extraction"
    authors: Zepeng Ding et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2406.11455
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11455
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 LLM 顺序抽取建模为 MDP，用 DDQN 训练 decision module
      自适应选择实体抽取顺序，提升复杂 IE 性能。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      RL for IE 的早期工作。用 RL 优化抽取策略而非模型本身，
      与我们 RSFT 直接微调 LLM 的方法路径不同。

  - title: "Graph-R1: Towards Agentic GraphRAG Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning"
    authors: Haoran Luo et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21892
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      用端到端 RL 优化 GraphRAG agent 的多轮检索-推理循环，
      包含 knowledge hypergraph construction（n-ary relation extraction）。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      RL + knowledge extraction 的交叉点。Graph-R1 关注 QA 场景下的知识图谱构建，
      我们关注 DocRE 的训练优化，应用场景不同。

  # === Category 8: Recent LLM-based DocRE Methods ===

  - title: "RelPrior: Relation as a Prior - A Novel Paradigm for LLM-based Document-level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.08143
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08143
    category: llm_docre
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      用 binary relation 作为先验过滤无关实体对，再用 predefined relation 匹配实体，
      避免 LLM 在 DocRE 中被无关实体对分散注意力。
      在 DocRED/Re-DocRED 上超越现有 LLM-based DocRE 方法。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      我们的直接 baseline 之一。RelPrior 在 DocRED 上提升 +2.06-2.38pp，
      我们的 RSFT 提升 +5.98pp 显著更优。
      RelPrior 是 inference paradigm 创新，我们是 training paradigm 创新，正交互补。

  - title: "LMRC: LLM with Relation Classifier for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2408.13889
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.13889
    category: llm_docre
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      两阶段方法：先用 attention-based classifier 过滤 NA 实体对（RCP），
      再用 LLM 在精简候选空间中做多分类（RC）。
      在 DocRED/Re-DocRED 上显著优于其他 LLM-based DocRE 方法。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      LMRC 用小模型预筛选 + LLM 分类的 pipeline 方式，与我们端到端 LLM 生成方式不同。
      展示 LLM-based DocRE 的 class imbalance 挑战，我们通过 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 隐式解决。

  - title: "Ru-LLM: Logical Rule-Constrained Large Language Models for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NLPCC 2025
    url: https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-95-3343-5_11
    category: llm_docre
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用频繁模式挖掘 + MCTS 搜索逻辑规则，转化为 prompt 约束 LLM 输出，
      再用 CoT 验证过滤不满足规则的 triple。
      在 DWIE、DocRED、Re-DocRED 上超越现有 LLM 方法和规则框架。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      规则约束方式与我们的 CED reward 在 motivation 上相似（都是引入外部知识约束），
      但 Ru-LLM 用 inference-time 规则验证，我们用 training-time reward shaping。

  - title: "GLiDRE: Generalist Lightweight model for Document-level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2508.00757
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00757
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      基于 dual-encoder 的轻量级零/少样本 DocRE 模型，
      在 Re-DocRED、FREDo 等 benchmark 的 few-shot 场景达到 SOTA。
      预训练于 136K 文档的大规模 RE 数据。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      不同范式（encoder-based vs LLM generative），
      但验证了 DocRE 领域仍有方法创新空间。

  - title: "AutoRE: Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.14888
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14888
    category: llm_docre
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RHF（Relation-Head-Facts）范式用 Mistral-7B + QLoRA 做端到端 DocRE，
      在多个 LLM 上达到 SOTA。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      QLoRA fine-tuning for DocRE 的先例。我们的 SFT baseline 与之类似，
      RSFT 在此基础上引入 reward-guided sample selection 进一步提升。

# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（放大 importance sampling 上界）和 Dynamic Sampling
      来对抗 entropy collapse，在 AIME 2024 上超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse；CED reward 本身就能防止 mode collapse，
      无需额外 clip 调整。reward design vs. algorithm trick 的对比。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化对低 variance 组（全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重引入 difficulty bias。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化项消除偏差，在 per-token 基础上表现更优。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      分析了 reward_std→0 时的问题（advantage 异常放大或归零），
      与我们观察到的 extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象高度一致。
      CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，避免了这一 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，

    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025

    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology

      structured output（DocRE）比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      而 rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
